_comment: Live strategy. Rewritten by strategist.weekly_review() via strategy.save_strategy(); schema and licence rules are documented in strategy.py. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored.
niche: Space & science moments plus notable congressional hearing exchanges, clipped from US federal government and CC-BY footage

allowlist._comment: Per source type: publishers whose uploads are eligible. Channels match on channel_id first, else case-insensitive exact channel name or handle. Domains match the URL host or any parent domain. any_channel=true means any channel passes as long as the per-video licence check passes (used for CC-BY).

channels.name: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory
channels.note: JPL is an FFRDC run by Caltech: check each video's description for third-party/Caltech copyright notices

channels.name: House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology
channels.note: Official committee feed; verify channel is linked from science.house.gov before first use

channels.name: Senate Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee
channels.note: Official committee feed; verify via commerce.senate.gov

channels.name: House Committee on Oversight and Accountability
channels.note: Official committee feed; verify via oversight.house.gov

_licence_comment: C-SPAN's own broadcasts and re-uploads by news outlets are copyrighted even when they show government proceedings: only official government-produced feeds count as US federal works. CC content must be CC-BY (not NC, ND or SA).
hook_style: Open with a 3-7 word on-screen question or bold claim taken from what is said in the first 3 seconds; no clickbait that the clip does not pay off; no emojis.
title_style: Under 70 characters, curiosity-driven but accurate, names the speaker or mission when known; no ALL CAPS words except acronyms.

experiment.hypothesis: Hooks phrased as a question retain viewers better than hooks phrased as a bold claim.
experiment.control: Open with a bold claim taken from the clip.
experiment.variant: Open with a question the clip answers.

notes: Initial strategy. Prioritise moments with a clear payoff inside 45 seconds: launches, landings, astronaut Q&A, sharp hearing exchanges. Always credit the source on screen and in the description.
